summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Marketbeta INTL Equity ETF (GSID) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of developed markets ex-North American equities selected and weighted by market capitalization. GSID was launched on May 12, 2020 and is issued by Goldman Sachs.

holdings.infoBox: GSID is an equity ETF with a total of 893 individual holdings. The top holdings are ASML Holding stock at 2.94%, HSBC Holdings at 1.55%, Roche Holding AG at 1.34%, Shell at 1.21%, and Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group at 1.20%.
